label: SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4: c here and now efficiently causes x's being, per se as caused
term: causes being as caused (the existential per se link of a series of efficient causes; Lean `CausesBeingAsCaused`)
definition: `CausesBeingAsCaused EfficientlyCausesIn esse AsCaused c x := EfficientlyCausesIn c x esse ∧ AsCaused c x`: here and now c efficiently causes the being of x (the secunda via's here-and-now efficient causing, DEF-EFFICIENT-CAUSING 69c0b23e, at the respect of being, DEF 5c308c8c), and c causes the being of x per se, as caused (AsCaused, the primitive per se link of PER_SE_5, DEF 4bca086d: c causes the esse of x only insofar as c's own esse is caused, so that c's being caused is not accidental to its causing x's being). It is the existential sense of the secunda via's per se link: a series of such links is a present series of causes of being, each middle member giving being only as itself receiving it. Analyst illustration (ST I q.104 a.1, not a claim): the sun's present causing of the light in the air, if the sun's own being is caused and the sun gives light's being only as so caused. Non-examples: the hand moving the stick (a cause of motion, not of the stick's being; it is a SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 link through c2880fe0); a man begetting a man (q.104 a.1: a cause of becoming, not directly of being); a builder of a house. It is distinct from SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 (CausesAsCaused, DEF 4a101a4c, any per se efficient link, a primitive with no respect), from PER_SE_5 (PerSeActualEsseCause, a mode-unspecified, tenseless cause of esse in the q.3 a.4 profile, with actuality of both relata), from grounding, from priority (PRIOR_1, PRIOR_4) and from moving. Neither inclusion with SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 is definitional: SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 into SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 is the OPEN bridge PerSeEsseLinkIsPerSeCauseLink, and the converse fails on the hand-and-stick case. Its passage into PER_SE_5 is the OPEN bridge PerSeEsseLinksArePerSeEsseCauses. No structural property (irreflexivity, transitivity, well-foundedness) is built in.
note: Analyst sense, attribution deferred (#1926, docs/notes/one-dependence-order.md, section 'Sense splits'). It is not attributed to the secunda via: ST I q.2 a.3 (pinned passage aba37900, read) speaks of an order of efficient causes in sensible things and does not restrict it to causes of the effect's being; q.46 a.2 ad 7 (a34be6a3, read) gives as per se series a series of movers (stone, stick, hand) and the generation of this man depending on this man, the elementary body and the sun, which by q.104 a.1 (f74e1b94, read in the English translation) mixes a cause of becoming only (the same-species generator) with a cause of being (the heavenly body). Q.104 a.1 shows that Aquinas has the notion of a per se cause of being ('when what is preserved depends on the preserver in such a way that it cannot exist without it'), and De ente c.4 runs a regress over causes of esse, but no read passage restricts the secunda via's series to it. It would be sourced by a passage restricting the per se series of efficient causes to causes of being. Reuse of PER_SE_5's AsCaused is deliberate (invariant 7): its definition already glosses it as per se causation of esse, so the existential link and PER_SE_5 share one per se primitive and differ in the efficient, here-and-now mode of causing and in the actuality of the relata.
